The monitored record's cap sits at the u16 field maximum (65535 bps), so the ceiling is 7.55 SOL. That is not 'no
cap': the same predicate still refuses anything above it.
23 bid(s) nobody met are not on this path: a skipped buy is a limit price, not a ticket price.
